Name: Phineas
Dialog: (wakes up) Ferb, are you hearing what I'm hearing? Candace singing. Early in the morning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, that's all right. I like that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Gasps) It's Mom's birthday! How can we forget Mom's birthday? Where have all the days gone? (Flashbacks start; Riding a Rollercoaster) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (In search of a mummy) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (Herding cattle) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (Surfing) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (On stage) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (Being chased by a dinosaur; Roaring) Isn't there something I'm supposed to remember? (Flashbacks end) We should do something nice for Mom, what with Dad being out of town on business and all.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Candace, once from the top.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I got an idea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom, let me be the first to say--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: [He and Ferb slam the door open onto their sister] Happy birthday, Mom! We brought you some periodicals - like Mom Daily, Mom Weekly, Mom Bi-weekly, and just the way you like it, a half-caff, double-frapp, mocha choco-latte mezzo-espresso.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, wow. You boys really outdid yourselves.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Au contraire, mon mere. I declare it's our mission to give you the best birthday ever. So relax, enjoy some reading, and no peeking till we come get you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, those boys are too much! Mmm. Oh, I smell eggs and bacon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro! We appreciate you helping us out. Ooh. Another call. (Beep) Talk to me. Buford, my man. Uh, hold on. [To Ferb] Needs roughage. [To Buford] Thanks, Buford. Glad we can count on you. (Candace clears throat) Hey, Candace. Wanna man the omelet station for Mom's birthday?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm doing my own thing. (Phineas and Ferb blinks) Well? Aren't you going to ask me what it is?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. Uh, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's a secret.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. 17 minutes ago, our spy satellites located Doofenshmirtz. He's hiding out in his mountaintop castle laboratory, where he's purchased some suspicious items over the internet, including a giant metal sphere and two animatronic wax robots, you know, like they have at theme parks. Gosh, those things give me the creeps, the way they're all robotic and waxy? (Shudders)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room, she’s making a crude birthday card) The boys may have won breakfast, but wait'll Mom sees this homemade birthday card. "Love, the child who loves you most, Candace."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Linda is blindfolded.) All right, Mom. Almost there.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, this is so exciting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, you can look.

Name: All
Dialog: Happy birthday!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Gasps) What a beautiful breakfast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Made with love.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And sweat.

Name: Linda
Dialog: And by "sweat", you mean hard work.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, this may not be a fantastic breakfast, but—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Mom's birthday card! (All gasp)

Name: Candace
Dialog: "To Mom"? Heh. It may be big, but bo-ring. (Broadway music as the card opens to be one spectacle)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, boys. I can't believe you two made it yourselves. (Candace's eye twitches twice in disbelief and she eats her birthday card)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, The Unicorn Whisperer, the feel-good movie of the year. And soon it will be gone. (Laughs maniacally; Agent P appears) Oh, no! It's Perry the Platypus! Ha! I fooled you, Perry the Platypus! I'm not really scared! (Laughs) I'm not scared, because I have a new security system. Voila! (door opens to reveal two robots that look like Abraham Lincoln and George Washington) Ha ha! Do you like them, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Wax Robots
Dialog: Get him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got them very cheap from a wax museum that went bankrupt. Ha ha! Ha ha ha! I love it when dreams fail. As you know, I've been trying to take over the Tri-State Area for quite some time now, and I realized this Tri-State area's filled with things I detest, so many things, like— (stops at a blinking traffic arrow) like blinking traffic arrows. Stop blinking at me, telling me where to go. Point. Point. Point. Ooh, I hate you. Let's see—what else? Ear hair. Oh, yes, I've always hated you. Pelicans. Terrible creatures. What—what are you, a bird or a garbage disposal? Ugh, musical instruments that start with the letter "B". You get the idea. It's a long list. I've been working on it for a while. Anyway, I realized I should build something that would make all those awful things disappear. Behold, Perry the Platypus — Shrink-spheria! You like it? I was going to call it a Shrinkinator, but I've done that whole "inator" thing before. It's just been done to death. Bring him over here! I want to show him how it works. I enter the name of something I hate. P-e-l-i-c-a-n. Pelican. And Shrink-spheria homes in on its molecular structure and then turns all the particles into sparticles, thereby shrinking it into a teeny, tiny speck so small I never have to see it again. So good-bye to you, Perry the Platypus. Enjoy your presidential suite! (Laughs maniacally and closes the door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Glad you like the card, Mom.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's a simple postmodern fusion of origami and pop-up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, and just wait till you see your present. Okay. Stay right there.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I hope the boys don't go overboard with my present. All I'd really like is that dress from that cute little sundress shop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean that really cute one with the polka dots? (goes out on her bike) I know what she wants. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Perry the Platypus, say goodbye to blinking detour signs! Forever! (Laughs maniacally; The Shrink sphere blasts and bye bye go the detour sign) Yes! I'm an evil genius! Ha ha ha ha! Now I have to wait 4 minutes for it to recharge, which isn't so bad. I think I'll go with pelicans next. What do you think Perry the Platypus? Pelicans next?

Name: Wax Washington Robot
Dialog: I cannot tell a lie. I'm melting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.  (with the blinging left-sing invisible, the moth van falls into a road hole and the moths fly away and fly around at the dress) Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yoo-hoo, Mr. Pelican, I'm going to shrink you now. Hee hee hee hee. Wh-why is it not working? Something's blocking the-- (sees Parry rattling the antenna) HEY! (he goes to Perry who proceeds to attack him)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, everybody! Look what— You got to be kidding me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our first supermodel sports a chic, stylin', notcouture sundress perfect for our birthday queen to sip iced lattes while enjoying a faboo day in the sun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hum. Well, they have the wrong sundress. It's okay, but it is not as great as this. (sees the moths on the dress) **AAAAAH!** (runs inside)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Candace? Where'd she go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! (he sees he pressed one of the buttons) Oh, well. Good-bye to musical instruments that start with "B"!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Panting) Wait a minute! I can still give mom the one thing the boys can't! The gift of music! Played on my friend: the bass. (A wave from Shrinkspheria washes over her; the bass guitar shrinks and disappears.) Huh. Oh, well, it's a good thing I play the banjo! (Banjo disappears) It's a good thing I play the bassoon! (Bassoon disappears) It's a good thing I play the bugle! (Bugle disappears) It's a good thing I play the bongos! (Bongos disappears)

Name: Timecard
Dialog: (man reads) "Five minutes later..."

Name: Candace
Dialog: (desperate) It's a good thing I play the balalaika! (Balalaika disappears) It's a good thing I play the bagpipe! (Bagpipe disappears, verge of crying I should've manned the omelet station!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (the deafeated Candace goes to the backyard) Candace, honey, come join us. The boys have put together a little video.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Here, you can do the honors.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine, whatever. [starts video]

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On video) Happy birthday, Mom. (Photos are shown of Linda from over the years.) From birth, to young adult, to mid-sized adult, from the 80s to the 90s, Mom enchants everyone she meets. But who is this person we call Mom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uhh... [The two wax robots appear]

Name: Wax Lincoln Robot
Dialog: (Whirring) A house divided cannot stand.

Name: Wax Washington Robot
Dialog: Yeah, what he said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, you melted their wax, but you can never melt what's inside—pure evil! (The two robots leap out, only to fall in the sphere making it explode] Ehh. I should have seen that coming.

Name: Wax Lincoln Robot
Dialog: We can't seem to get a break.

Name: Wax Washington Robot
Dialog: Your breath smells like candles.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isn't this wonderful?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Yeah, really great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On video) But a true testament to what a great Mom you are, is that your daughter would take the time to write this song.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice song, sis. (Ferb gives a thumbs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (goes over to hug Candace) What a beautiful song, honey! I only wish Dad could have heard it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I really wanted you to have a happy bir--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, I almost forgot. We set up a satellite up-link with Dad.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh, a satellite up-link.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (On screen) Hello, love. Happy birthday.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, honey! I miss you. And you're missing the festivities. The boys threw me the greatest party. And Candace wrote me this really amazing song. Can you hear me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (the platypus appears) Oh, hey, Perry. Where have you been? You missed all the fun. (Perry chatters; Fade to black)
